disclaimer: Illustrative investigative check shipped with the prototype. It is not derived from any verified or suppressed incident, and a match is not evidence of fraud. Set thresholds from your own policy before use.
name: Payment recorded without a purchase-order reference
description: Flags payments whose source record supplies a purchase-order reference field that is blank. Records whose source does not include the field at all return insufficient data instead.

conditions.description: The purchase-order reference is supplied but blank

support.assumption: Most procurement policies expect payments to trace to an approved order; confirm against your own policy.

benignExplanations: Payment category exempt from purchase orders (utilities, taxes, payroll-related)
Reference held in a different field or system
falsePositiveConsiderations: Exempt categories must be filtered before this check is meaningful
